summary: ModelBroker is implemented as the only model boundary with structured plan/classify/summarize/sanitize requests, deterministic StubModelProvider, metadata-only call logs, bounded output checks, secret-like input rejection, and fail-closed timeout/provider failure behavior.

verification.command: rg -n "StubModelProvider|ModelBroker|provider\.plan|\.plan\(&recovery_request|model provider|remote model|local model" crates docs .workflow --glob '!target/**'
verification.result: Provider implementation and direct plan calls are confined to agent_core::model_broker and tests; docs/workflow files only describe the boundary.

acceptance.criterion: AgentCore can plan through StubModelProvider without network access.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::model_broker::tests::stub_provider_plans_without_network_or_effects validates deterministic local-only planning and absence of EffectPrepared/EffectObserved/CommitSealed strings.

acceptance.criterion: Invalid model output is rejected before it becomes a PlanSpec.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::model_broker::tests::malformed_provider_output_is_rejected_before_plan_spec rejects shell.exec raw output through ToolRouter validation.

acceptance.criterion: Timeouts and provider failures degrade to Suspended or FailedClosed, not tool execution.
acceptance.evidence: timeout/cancel tests map to Suspended; provider failure and oversized output map to FailedClosed; tests assert no EffectPrepared in failure logs.

acceptance.criterion: ModelBroker calls are logged with metadata but not raw secret values.
acceptance.evidence: call_log_contains_metadata_not_raw_prompt_or_secret_values asserts provider/model/latency metadata exists and raw prompt/secret-like keys are absent.

acceptance.criterion: No module except ModelBroker directly calls model providers.
acceptance.evidence: source search found StubModelProvider direct use only inside agent_core::model_broker implementation/tests; docs describe the boundary.

model_broker_contract.side_effect_path: none; ModelBroker returns structured data only
